text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yo. It's finally here…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I saw it, The 1st. You're number one again, huh? Still the same idol as ever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, I'm sitting in eighth. Given what I've accomplished so far, that's a fair assessment, I suppose… Still. Can't say it doesn't sting.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …No. That's not how you really feel, is it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You're really excited, aren't you? I can feel your heart pounding too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh… Even you, little lady, can't fool me with that innocent act.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Buena. I'm grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh…?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Buena! Buena! Buena! Buena! Buena!
BU-E-NA VIS-TAAA!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Is that the Buena fan club? With the Spring Grand Prix coming up, looks like she's picked up even more fans.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You're acting like you've been here forever, but you're a newcomer too! Come on, let's cheer just as hard! Go win again, Buena!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks to your popularity… this whole place is swelling with one enormous expectation.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Which is why this is going to be the biggest upset of them all. I'm really glad you're in my generation, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …There won't be an upset, though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Oh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I know how hard you've been working, Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: If you win, it'll be because of all the effort you've put in every day… not because of some upset.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Oi oi. You were supposed to fire back at me there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I can really feel how fired up you are, Nakayama. But…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I've got the expectations of so many people resting on my shoulders too. I can't afford to lose!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …My self-interest versus your selflessness. I guess this race is going to decide which one's stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I like it. Let's clash fair and square.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Phew.
choice_data_list: Wow… Nakayama was really fired up.
Wow… Nakayama was really fired up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She must've trained really hard for today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I need to get myself into race mode too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista looks perfectly calm. But she's carrying the expectations of so many people again today. I can't know what she's feeling deep down…

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm really okay now. I don't get nervous at all anymore.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: If anything, I'm happy about everyone's expectations. I'll answer them, and answer them… until I reach that breathtaking view! That's all I can think about.
choice_data_list: Are you sure? You're not carrying too much tension?
Are you sure? You're not carrying too much tension?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yep!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You're unusually worried today, aren't you? What's gotten into you?
choice_data_list: I don't exactly know what it feels like to be in your shoes.
I don't exactly know what it feels like to be in your shoes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Even if it means worrying too much, I want to make sure I'm looking out for you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you. You're so dependable… That's why I really am okay.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm going to win. I'll win… and answer the expectations of all those people.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll picture the breathtaking view I want to reach today… and then I'll tell you all about it!
